Voice Tools DSP oracle fixtures

Generated by executing DevExtras.Common.Audio.dll from the official Apple Voice Tools
2.0.186 installation on an Apple silicon Mac with .NET 10 and Apple Accelerate.
DLL SHA-256: fe3a1c4e087f0d68e99b97e121b1d97681afcfc631adcdaabdde933634d875a9

24 deterministic synthetic cases at 8/16 kHz: silence, 250/1000 Hz tones, a quiet
tone, off-bin tone, two tones, DC step, impulse, chirp, harmonic stack, seeded noise,
and a Nyquist signal. Each fixture contains the original preprocessed input (before
DC/windowing) and the original shifted/clipped dB spectrum. No executable code or
recorded personal audio is embedded. The fixture is an independently executed
reference; tests must not regenerate it from Soundglow's implementation.

These establish the FFT/window/level stage, not iPhone microphone, Apple resampler,
rendering, or live capture parity. The settings stream tests additionally exercise
Praat resampling at 24/44.1/48 kHz and check continuous 16 ms frame timestamps.
